item.title: Toronto man fined for massive bass overlimit near Pembroke
item.description: An individual from Southern Ontario has been fined $5,000 for a fishing violation in Algonquin Park near Pembroke. Mykola Bondaruk of Toronto has pleaded guilty to possessing 67 bass over the legal limit. He was fined $5,000 and is prohibited from all fishing-related activities in Ontario for one year.
